description: The BOSCH GBM 400 Professional Corded Drill Machine keyed version is designed to deliver reliable drilling performance for professional and household applications. Powered by a 420W rated input motor, it provides strong and consistent drilling power across materials like wood, metal and plastic. With a variable speed range of 0-3100 RPM, the drill allows better control and precision depending on the material and drilling requirement. The 10mm keyed chuck ensures secure drill bit holding, while the forward and reverse rotation function enables both drilling and screwdriving tasks. Its compact and lightweight design ensures comfortable handling even during extended work sessions, making it ideal for professionals such as electricians, carpenters, technicians as well as DIY users.
